home.title: Routines
home.subtitle: A few small tool actions that go together. Done when you do them - no streaks, no pressure.
home.emptyBody: A routine strings a few small tool actions together - a check-in, a line of gratitude, a short breath. Steps complete themselves when you use the tools.
home.starterBody: Composed from the tools already on your Home. Keep it as is, or skip - you can always build your own.

strip.label: Last 7 days
strip.note: Filled days are days the whole routine came together. Empty days are just empty - one missed day doesn't undo what you're building.

detail.stepsEmpty: No steps yet - add some in the editor.
detail.orderNote: Order is just a suggestion - do the steps in any order, or leave some for another day.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: Delete this routine and its steps? Your tool entries are untouched. This can't be undone.

onboarding.title: One small routine to start?
onboarding.body: We put together a tiny routine from the tools you just picked. Keep it if it helps - nothing is created unless you say so.
onboarding.stepsNote: Steps complete themselves when you use the tools - nothing to tick off, and no reminders unless you add one later.

form.nameRequired: Give the routine a short name.
form.saveError: Could not save the routine. Please try again.
form.stepsHelp: Each step points at a tool. It completes on days you use that tool - nothing to tick off.
form.stepsEmpty: No steps yet. Add a tool below.
form.onDemandHelp: Runs only when you start it yourself - no reminders.
form.customDaysRequired: Pick at least one day for a custom cadence.

reminder.help: One gentle notification a day, at a time you pick. It stays off unless you turn it on.
reminder.channelError: Notifications couldn't be turned on for this device, so the routine was saved with the reminder off. You can try again anytime.

overlap.note: Some steps also have their own tool reminder. That's fine - nothing changes unless you choose to.
overlap.turnOffError: Couldn't turn off the {{tool}} reminder. Please try again.

widget.metaDesc: All your routines' progress for the day in one calm card.
widget.title: Routines today
widget.allDone: Everything came together today. Nothing left to do here.
widget.emptyBody: A routine strings a few small tool actions together. If you'd like one, the Routines page is the place to start.

sheet.title: Continue your routine
sheet.orderNote: Order is just a suggestion - any step, any order.
sheet.completeBody: "{{name}}" came together today. There's nothing more to do here.
sheet.reminderOffer: If it would help, this routine can nudge you once a day. It stays off unless you turn it on.
sheet.reminderSaveError: Could not save the reminder. You can set it any time from the routine.
